mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT s.service_key, s.service_name, s.service_type, s.service_en, s.index, s.icon, sr.child_service_key, s2.service_key AS parent_service_key, s2.service_name AS parent_service_name, s2.service_en AS parent_service_en, s3.service_name AS child_service_name, s3.service_en AS child_service_en FROM public.service s LEFT JOIN public.service_relations sr ON (sr.parent_service_key = s.service_key OR sr.child_service_key = s.service_key) LEFT JOIN public.service s2 ON s2.service_key = sr.parent_service_key LEFT JOIN public.service s3 ON s3.service_key = sr.child_service_key WHERE (s.service_type = 'main_menu' OR s.service_type = 'sub_menu') AND s.service_name ILIKE '%' || TRIM(#{service_name}) || '%' ORDER BY s.service_name, s2.service_name
